businesses.story: A cafe inside the 17th-century close where Deacon William Brodie lived his double life — respected councilor by day, head of a burglary gang by night. Hanged 1788. Robert Louis Stevenson used him as the seed for Dr Jekyll and Mr Hyde. The cafe serves smoked Ayrshire bacon, free-range eggs, home-made scones with Craigie's Farm jam, organic Fairtrade coffee.

design.palette: Edinburgh slate-grey + Scottish heather purple + whisky amber + parchment + flame orange (rooted in Brodie's Close stone, heather moors, Scotch whisky)
design.layout: Dual-identity scroll grammar — day cafe up top (light parchment), night history at bottom (dark slate), bridged by Stevenson quote divider. Scroll triggers day-to-night palette transition.
design.motion: Two signature motions: (1) fixed gaslamp SVG with irregular candle-flicker animation top-right; (2) vertical tartan-rule down left edge that fills with woven tartan pattern proportional to scroll position. Neither exists on any other site in the radar.

emailDraft.subject: Your cafe in Brodie's Close — a quiet idea for the front of house
emailDraft.body:
Hello,

I walked through Brodie's Close last week and stopped at Deacon's House Cafe. The smoked salmon on the artisan farmhouse bread was excellent, and the cream tea was the most honest one I've had in Edinburgh in a long while.

I noticed Google Maps doesn't link a website for you — and the older site at deaconshousecafe.co.uk isn't connected from there, so most people walking past on the Royal Mile never find it. I make small, beautiful sites for cafes like yours and I built two previews for Deacon's, free, to show what's possible.

The quiet editorial one (perfect for a Royal Mile cafe):
https://giladmeishar.github.io/cowork-radar/deacon-house-cafe-edinburgh-20260525-basic.html

And the one I really wanted to make — built around the 1788 story, with the day cafe up top and the Brodie history at the bottom, the way the close itself feels:
https://giladmeishar.github.io/cowork-radar/deacon-house-cafe-edinburgh-20260525-premium.html

The domain deaconshousecafe.com is available at around £12/year. If you ever wanted to use either of these, or wanted me to adjust them, just reply and I'll make any change you ask for. Otherwise, please ignore — I won't email a second time.

With warm regards from a guest who enjoyed your scones.

—
This is a one-time message. If you'd rather I didn't email again, just reply with 'no thanks' and I will note it down.

emailDraft.subject: Un'idea per Anna Maria — una piccola cortesia da un ospite
emailDraft.body:
Buongiorno,

Ho cenato da voi qualche settimana fa — i tortellini in brodo erano come quelli che mia nonna sognava, e la sfoglia delle tagliatelle al ragù si scioglieva. Una serata davvero bella.

Ho notato che avete un sito (trattoriannamaria.com) ma è piuttosto essenziale. Io costruisco piccoli siti curati per trattorie di famiglia come la vostra, e ho preparato due bozze gratuite per Anna Maria — solo per mostrarvi come potrebbe essere:

Classico (semplice ma curato):
https://giladmeishar.github.io/cowork-radar/anna-maria-trattoria-bologna-20260526-basic.html

Quello che volevo davvero fare — ocra bolognese, foto della vostra entrata, il menu nella sua forma giusta:
https://giladmeishar.github.io/cowork-radar/anna-maria-trattoria-bologna-20260526-premium.html

Niente di vincolante. Se vi piacciono e volete usarli (o adattarli), rispondete e li passo a voi. Altrimenti, ignorate questa email — non vi scriverò di nuovo.

Grazie per la cena.

—
Questo è un messaggio singolo, non vi scriverò di nuovo.
